title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Terms: One Authorization per Agreement and Agreements AutoPay Covers
content:
**Clause 1 — Scope of an authorization.** A tenant may hold one Bluegate AutoPay Authorization per rental agreement. A tenant with several agreements therefore holds several authorizations, and each authorization drafts only its own agreement. No ceiling applies to the number of authorizations one tenant holds across different agreements.

**Clause 2 — One live authorization on an agreement.** From the tenant's point of view an agreement may have only one authorization in pending-verification or active status at one time. A new enrollment on an agreement that already has one is accepted as a replacement, and the older authorization is retired when the new one is verified.

**Clause 3 — Agreements covered.** AutoPay covers storage unit agreements and vehicle, RV and boat parking agreements only. Truck rentals, protection fees billed separately and business invoices are not drafted.

**Clause 4 — Limit on new authorizations.** The number of authorizations on one agreement whose enrollment date falls within the rolling window of 365 calendar days ending on the handling date, the handling date included, must be below the method's ceiling on new authorizations per agreement in any rolling 365 days for a new authorization to be set up on that agreement.

### Clause 4 in condition and result form

| Authorizations on the agreement with an enrollment date inside the 365-day window | Compared with the method's ceiling | New authorization on that agreement |
|---|---|---|
| Fewer than the ceiling | below | may be set up |
| Equal to the ceiling | not below | may not be set up |
| More than the ceiling | not below | may not be set up |

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A tenant with two storage units and one parking space may hold three authorizations, one on each agreement; the authorization on the parking agreement never drafts either unit.
- A method whose ceiling is a hypothetical 5: an agreement showing 4 authorizations enrolled inside the window may take a new one (4 is below 5); an agreement showing 5 may not.
- A tenant whose unit agreement has an active Debit Card authorization enrolls Personal Checking ACH on the same agreement: the new enrollment is a replacement, and the Debit Card authorization is retired when the checking account is verified.
- A truck rental contract cannot be put on AutoPay; neither can a protection fee billed separately or a business invoice.
